selection: Two random examples per class from held-out test, seed 2026

atypical_example.description: A fully bright 8x8 matrix; syntactically valid but unlike handwritten digits
atypical_example.response: Accepted by shape/range checks; model still returns a digit (no rejection option).
atypical_example.caution: This is evidence of atypicality for this dataset, not a universal OOD detector.

interpretation: 20 examples are insufficient to claim general robustness. Small perturbations may flip labels even when each pixel remains within the allowed range. Shape validation cannot detect atypical but numerically valid pictures.
proposed_defense: Investigate calibrated abstention or distance-based anomaly screening on a separate validation set.
